elevate.move: Make type carry the magazine: one italic Fraunces deck line under every department h2 at a single size, one mono caption style per view, no middle-dot meta strings, so the serif voice reads as an edited issue and mono is reserved for figure captions and prices.

Turn Classifieds into a true classified page: dense ruled newspaper columns whose card heights follow their content (no empty card interiors), with the Wanted ad set as a boxed ad across the column foot, making it the dense peak of the scroll before Pipe Froze? breathes.
